name: file-upload
title: File upload
description: Pick files with a button or by dropping them, validate size and type, and show each file with its progress or error.

when: People add documents or photos to a form or record.

instead.when: One picture must be framed to a fixed shape before it is saved.
A link or path to the file is typed instead of picked.

keyboard.does: Opens the file picker from the trigger or drop zone.

builtIn: Rejected files explain why (size, type, count).
Upload progress is exposed as a progress bar.
youProvide: A label that says what to add.
